en: Sari looks out of her window at night. A round, bright Moon looks back. 'Hello, Moon!'
A few nights later, the Moon looks thinner, like a big smile in the sky.
Some nights later, Sari can see only a thin silver curve, like a fingernail.
One night Sari looks and looks. Where is the Moon? The sky is dark, but the stars twinkle.
Night by night, the Moon grows rounder again. Sari waves. 'You came back, Moon!'
id: Sari melihat ke luar jendela pada malam hari. Bulan yang bulat dan terang seperti balas menatapnya. 'Halo, Bulan!'
Beberapa malam kemudian, Bulan terlihat lebih tipis, seperti senyum besar di langit.
Beberapa malam setelahnya, Sari hanya melihat lengkungan perak yang tipis, seperti kuku jari.
Suatu malam Sari mencari dan terus mencari. Di mana Bulan? Langit gelap, tetapi bintang-bintang berkelip.
Malam demi malam, Bulan kembali membulat. Sari melambai. 'Kamu kembali, Bulan!'

readAloudNotes.en: Make a big circle with both arms and wave hello to the Moon.
readAloudNotes.id: Buat lingkaran besar dengan kedua lengan dan lambaikan tangan ke Bulan.

readAloudNotes.en: Draw a smile shape in the air with your finger.
readAloudNotes.id: Gambar bentuk senyum di udara dengan jari.

readAloudNotes.en: Show your child your thumbnail and compare it to the thin Moon.
readAloudNotes.id: Tunjukkan kuku ibu jari kepada anak dan bandingkan dengan Bulan yang tipis.

readAloudNotes.en: Cover your eyes and look around, then open and close your fingers like twinkling stars.
readAloudNotes.id: Tutup mata dan pura-pura mencari, lalu buka-tutup jari seperti bintang berkelip.

readAloudNotes.en: Make the circle with your arms again and wave happily.
readAloudNotes.id: Buat lingkaran dengan lengan lagi dan melambai dengan gembira.

objectives.en: Listens to a story about how the Moon seems to change shape over many nights.
objectives.id: Mendengarkan cerita tentang bulan yang tampak berubah bentuk selama banyak malam.

objectives.en: Uses shape words: round, thin, curve.
objectives.id: Menggunakan kata bentuk: bulat, tipis, lengkung.

meaning.en: shaped like a circle or a ball
a line that bends, like a smile
to shine on and off a little

prompt.en: What shape was the Moon at the start?
prompt.id: Bagaimana bentuk Bulan di awal cerita?

prompt.en: When Sari could not see the Moon, what could she see?
prompt.id: Saat Sari tidak bisa melihat Bulan, apa yang bisa ia lihat?

prompt.en: Did the Moon really go away for ever?

en: no, it was still there and came back
id: tidak, Bulan tetap ada dan terlihat lagi

connection.en: The Moon looks a different shape on different nights, and the pattern repeats about every month.
connection.id: Bulan terlihat berbeda bentuk pada malam yang berbeda, dan polanya berulang kira-kira setiap bulan.

discussionPrompts.en: What shape is the Moon tonight?
discussionPrompts.id: Bentuk Bulan malam ini seperti apa?

discussionPrompts.en: What else do you see in the night sky?
discussionPrompts.id: Apa lagi yang kamu lihat di langit malam?

offlineActivity.en: For a week, look at the Moon together before bed (if you can see it) and draw its shape on a paper calendar each night.
offlineActivity.id: Selama seminggu, lihat Bulan bersama sebelum tidur (jika terlihat) dan gambar bentuknya di kalender kertas setiap malam.

factChecks.claim: The Moon appears to change shape over about a month and then the cycle repeats.
On some nights the Moon cannot be seen at all.
